verifiedLimits.outputBudgetAccounting: The output budget reserves 128 KiB for lifecycle events and counts each serialized probe event plus 1024 bytes of envelope allowance. Tests independently assert complete public-shaped event JSON stays within 16 KiB and aggregate persisted output remains within 2 MiB.
verifiedLimits.truncation: Output is dropped at the bounded queue, run budget or credential-prefix limit and an explicit truncated=true notice is emitted.

toolOutputTests.name: remote shell output is visible within a batch interval and is flushed before tool completion
toolOutputTests.assertions: A fixture command remains running while its first output batch is observed after a 330 ms wait. Remaining output precedes tool.end; tool identity is preserved; hidden reasoning fixture text is absent.

toolOutputTests.name: UTF-8 and JSON-expanded output is bounded per event and per run with explicit truncation
toolOutputTests.assertions: Large Chinese, emoji, NUL, quote, backslash and newline output is split without replacement characters. Every independently constructed complete event envelope is at most 16 KiB; total output is at most 2 MiB and truncation is explicit.

toolOutputTests.name: credentials remain redacted when their values and labels cross timed batches
toolOutputTests.assertions: Known model and sandbox fixture keys plus unknown Bearer and api_key values are redacted when values or labels cross multiple chunks and 280 ms waits. Concatenating visible batches does not reconstruct the credentials.

toolOutputTests.name: file tools expose useful result summaries without copying source or edit diffs into logs
toolOutputTests.assertions: Actual Pi write, read and edit calls produce path-specific summaries. Source body and edited source identifiers are absent from public logs.

toolOutputTests.name: a failed output persistence barrier stops the run and discards later output
toolOutputTests.assertions: A rejected output sink causes EVENT_APPEND_FAILED instead of being consumed as an ordinary Pi tool error. Later output is absent and no delayed event appears after settlement.

toolOutputTests.name: cancelling a command discards its pending batch and leaves no delayed output
toolOutputTests.assertions: Abort before a pending batch flush produces CANCELLED. Invoking the retained external output callback after settlement and waiting 300 ms produces no public tool output. This is fixture cancellation evidence, not proof of stopping a real model or remote process.

toolOutputTests.name: a slow persistence sink has bounded queued batches and completes them before tool.end
toolOutputTests.assertions: A blocked sink receives one in-flight batch while a burst fills the bounded queue. Persistence callbacks remain serial; no more than one in-flight plus eight queued batches and one truncation notice are emitted, all before tool.end.

toolOutputTests.name: the total output budget holds across many successfully persisted batches
toolOutputTests.assertions: Four hundred paced 8 KiB external chunks exercise the run budget without relying on a slow-sink overflow. Persisted output exceeds 1 MiB, stays within 2 MiB, and contains exactly one truncation notice.

toolOutputTests.name: an unfinished credential label cannot accumulate an unbounded pending buffer
toolOutputTests.assertions: An api_key label followed by 100000 spaces and a value triggers bounded-prefix truncation; the credential value is absent from public output.
